[6:19PM] #OguduAlapere #TrafficUpdate 

Descending Gbagada Bridge and Olopomeji towards the Car Wash area is moving smoothly.
However, traffic is slow but steady from Car Wash area towards Ifako due to ongoing repairs of the damaged expansion joint on the Ifako/Ogudu link bridge.
Leaving Ifako Bridge towards Ogudu Estate, Alapere, and down to Apostolic Church is relatively clear.
The stretch from Apostolic Church to Ojota Bridge and down to Ikosi Junction is moving well.
Ikosi Junction to Tollgate, Secretariat, and down to Otedola Bridge is a smooth ride.

Returning from Otedola Bridge to Secretariat and down to Car Wash is also moving nicely.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:30PM] #OkeOdoAbuleEgba #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is moving well from Abule Egba underneath Jubilee Bridge, where traffic light alternations are in place, all the way to Oja Oba, down to Charity Junction, where another set of traffic light alternations are in place, inward Charity Road connecting to Social Club, Olayiwola Junction, and Abbattoir.

There's also good vehicular movement from Super inward Ile Epo down to Pleasure, and back to Abule Egba Jubilee via Ile Epo on the return journey.

On the Lagos/Abeokuta Express Road, traffic is free-flowing from Ahmadiyya, Ijaiye, and Kola Alakuko down to Ajegunle, and the return journey from Toll Gate inward Amje, Moshalashi, Meiran Junction, Casso, and down to Awori U-turn is also moving well.

Despite potential impediments, officers are on ground to monitor traffic within the corridor.

#FollowLASTMA

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 52 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 24 July 2025(Thursday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Cavite, Bataan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna, Zambales(San Antonio, Subic, Castillejos, Olongapo) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Tuy, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan, Calaca, Laurel, Talisay, Tanauan, Lemery, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Balete, Malvar, Santo Tomas).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Pampanga, Batangas(Alitagtag, Batangas City, Bauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Taal, Taysan, Tingloy), Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan), Zambales(Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, San Felipe, San Narciso) and Bulacan(Calumpit, Paombong, Hagonoy, Pulilan, Malolos, Plaridel, Guiguinto, Bulakan, Obando, Meycauayan, Balagtas, Bocaue, Marilao).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Bulacan(Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, Pandi, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria) and Quezon(Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

[6:52PM] #Marina #TrafficUpdate 

There's a good movement from UBA Roundabout towards NNPC Filling Station, inward Cathedral Church down to Nitel Intersection.

Good movement is observed from State House connecting to Force Road.

Traffic is moving slow and steady from Bony Camp towards Zone 2 underneath bridge, approaching Flagstaff House, and connecting McWen Bridge.

Movement from Onikan Roundabout towards TBS, inward Water Board, and connecting to Nitel Intersection is good.

The entire stretch of Broad Street is clear, with good traffic flow from General Hospital towards Tinubu Square, connecting Abibu Oki Street, but approaching Balogun Junction inward Apongbon is slow and steady.

Traffic is moving faster on the stretch of Igbosere Road and Catholic Mission Street, connecting Ganiu Smith Street.

There's no major impediment, and officers are on ground managing the traffic effectively.

#FollowLASTMA
